setting.help: Users who approve warranty cases of customers with overdue invoices, when the warranty policy's Overdue Claim Handling is Approval Required. A user never approves their own request.

If enabled, only the Warranty Case Approval Users can approve or reject eligible warranty cases, and never a case they created or checked. If disabled, any Helpdesk user of the company can approve or reject them. In both cases approval is a manual step.
Users who approve or reject eligible warranty cases when approval is required. They cannot approve a case they created or whose eligibility they checked.
Helpdesk managers who can allow a free service after its grace period has ended. If empty, all Helpdesk managers of the company can approve. A user never approves their own request.
Managers who confirm the warranty of products with repeated failures. A user never confirms their own escalation.
